scenes.name: A SUM NEEDS AN ORIGIN
lines: Adding two points needs a zero, and a sphere has none.
两点相加需要一个零点，而球面上没有。
Move the origin, and the point a plus b moves with it.
原点一动，a + b 这个点就跟着动。
But a minus b plus c stays put: the step from b to a, repeated from c.
a − b + c 却纹丝不动：从 b 到 a 的那一步，从 c 出发再走一遍。
On the sphere, i plus j even pokes out: its squared length is two.
在单位球面上，i + j 甚至刺破球壳：它的长度平方是 2。

scenes.name: THE HEAP
lines: So use a three-point bracket: a times b-bar times c, in whole numbers, with x, x, z giving z.
于是改用三点括号：a 乘 b 的共轭再乘 c，全是整数；[x, x, z] 给出 z。
Order is kept: i, one, j gives k, but j, one, i gives minus k.
次序被保留：[i, 1, j] 是 k，[j, 1, i] 却是 −k。
Pick any home o, and Lean checks the bracket splits as x, times y inverse, times z.
任选一点 o 当作家，Lean 内核检验：括号恰好拆成 x 乘 y 的逆再乘 z。

scenes.name: RELATION OF RELATIONS
lines: For u, one one zero, and v, one zero two, the commutator is four, minus four, minus two.
Against w, zero one one, the Lie triple bracket gives minus one, minus two, two.
再与 w = (0, 1, 1) 比较，利雅三元括号给出 (−1, −2, 2)。
Cycle and add: zero. Lean checks this Bianchi identity for all integer vectors.
轮换后相加：得零。Lean 内核对一切整向量检验了这条比安基恒等式。
Set w to u: against v the bracket gives nine, and so does the squared area.
令 w = u：括号与 v 的内积是 9，面积平方也是 9。
Lean checks every nondegenerate rational plane: curvature exactly one, no charts, no Christoffel symbols.
Lean 内核检验每个非退化有理切面：曲率恰为 1，无需坐标卡与克氏符号。

scenes.name: TEN VERSUS FIVE
lines: A ray forgets a sign: p and minus p are one ray, read in ten slots.
射线会忘掉符号：p 与 −p 是同一条射线，读数落在 10 个槽位里。
Ten integer rays fill them all, Gram determinant one sixty-fourth. An eleventh adds nothing.
十条整射线把槽位填满，格拉姆行列式为 1/64；第十一条什么也不添。
The signed overlap has only five slots: five spinors give one thirty-second.
有号读数只有 5 个槽位：五枚旋量给出 1/32。
Lean checks the bridge: square two kappa-spin minus one, and you get the ray overlap.
Lean 内核检验这座桥：把 2κ_spin − 1 平方，就得到射线读数。

scenes.name: THE REFLECTION WALK
lines: Now let the heap walk: from e, step to g, one one one one over two.
现在让流群走起来：从 e 出发，迈一步到 g = (1, 1, 1, 1; 2)。
Each new point reflects the one before through the current one: x two is g, e, g.
每个新点都是把前一点隔着当前点反射过去：x₂ = [g, e, g]。
Lean checks this walk is the power sequence: x n is b to the n.
Lean 内核检验：这条反射之路就是幂次序列，xₙ = bⁿ。

scenes.name: SEVEN HUNDRED TWENTY
lines: Each beat turns space a hundred and twenty degrees about the cube's diagonal.
每一拍把空间绕立方体的体对角线转 120°。
The signed overlap reads three quarters, one quarter, then zero at beat three.
有号读数依次是 3/4、1/4，第三拍变成 0。
The ray overlap already reads one: space looks home, the spinor sits at minus e.
射线读数此时已是 1：空间看似回了家，旋量却停在 −e。
Only at beat six, seven hundred twenty degrees, do both read one. Lean checks the orbit.
直到第六拍、720°，两者才都读出 1。Lean 内核检验了整条轨道。

scenes.name: NO SPECIAL POINT
lines: On real unit quaternions, a second square, with y times i, gives the Hopf sphere.
在实单位四元数上，再加一项与 y·i 的平方读数，就得到霍普夫球面。
For e and g, a quarter plus a quarter is a half, and the Hopf images, i and j, are perpendicular.
对 e 与 g：1/4 加 1/4 等于 1/2，霍普夫像 i 与 j 互相垂直。
Pairs with equal overlap are carried onto each other by p z q. Lean checks both.
读数相同的两对点，能被 p z q 一齐搬到对方身上。两条结论都由 Lean 内核检验。
No point is special: the sphere never needed an origin.
没有哪个点是特殊的：球面从来不需要原点。

lines: Omega Math, chapter four.
《OMEGA MATH》· 第四章
